subtitle: Building retail-orders-analytics' first real CI file

code:
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
caption: Runs on every PR into main, and every push to main.

code:
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v4
  - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
    with:
      python-version: "3.11"
  - run: pip install dbt-postgres==1.7.4
  - run: dbt deps
caption: Checkout, then Python, then dbt itself — top to bottom.
The Actions tab lives right alongside Code, Issues, and Pull requests.
Each workflow file gets its own row here, named after its name: field.
